purpose: Mark an endpoint; in an additional use, include an unexpected item.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Time / place + まで (until / as far as); noun + まで (even).
Let us walk as far as the station.
Even my usually quiet younger sister started singing.
formation: Time / place + まで (until / as far as); noun + まで (even).
restrictions: Endpoint まで describes a range or duration; までに sets a deadline. Additive まで extends the set to an unexpected item, a use beyond the elementary endpoint sense.
mistake: Read the context: まで can mean even without naming a time or place. Use までに for a completion deadline.
